lead_raw_text:
The structure of V₂SiN crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6₃/mmc (No. 194), with a unit cell containing eight atoms—four V, two Si, and two N—distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows each N center coordinated by five V neighbors and each Si center by nine neighbors (six N and three V), while each V center has nine geometric neighbors (six N and three Si). This analysis also identifies a three-dimensional connected neighbor graph spanning all eight sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing contacts include corner and face sharing between V 9-vertex polyhedra and between N 5-vertex and V 9-vertex polyhedra, with edge sharing between V 9-vertex polyhedra.
